request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, administered by Intersect for the vendor MLabs
request.what: Withdraw treasury funds for annual maintenance and enhancement of MLabs Core Tool Maintenance & Enhancement: Plutarch and Ply.

claims.claim: Plutarch is a Haskell eDSL for creating efficient Cardano smart contracts through controlled compilation into UPLC, and Ply serializes Plutarch scripts to and from CIP-57 blueprint-style artifacts with inferred types.

MLabs says Plutarch and Ply have been extensively used in the Cardano ecosystem, citing an internal audit that counted at least 26 teams in one section and at least 15 teams in another section building with the tools.
MLabs says public cross-language benchmarks show Plutarch scripts rank among the smallest in the benchmark suite while requiring comparatively low on-chain compute and memory.
The proposal states that continued maintenance is needed so Plutarch and Ply can track Cardano ledger, Plutus, tooling, and possible Dijkstra-era protocol changes during the funding period.
The proposal claims loss of maintenance could create friction, migration risk, bespoke workarounds, expensive smart-contract stack migrations, or avoidable rewrites for existing adopters.
The proposal claims alignment with Cardano 2030 Pillar 2 by supporting developer experience and maintenance of open-source SDKs, frameworks, and infrastructure.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission.
The proposal states the requested amount does not breach the 350M ada Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at submission, either alone or in aggregate.
The budget totals 1,162,746 ada, consisting of 1,128,880 ada for Plutarch and Ply maintenance, compatibility, and developer experience plus a 33,866 ada Intersect administration fee.

The proposal states Intersect will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with TRSC and PSSC addresses, external oversight entities, multi-party authorization thresholds, and a public dashboard for auditability.

summary: The document requests 1,162,746 ada for annual Plutarch and Ply maintenance and enhancement, routed through Intersect-administered treasury smart contracts, and supports the ask with budget details, governance-process references, prior-funding disclosures, oversight mechanics, and several proposer assertions about adoption and maintenance risk.
